message.content:
Build GIFT/CREDIT CODES and the WALLET AUTO-RECHARGE preferences UI for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth"`; admin `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `await requireArea("billing")`. Money = integer cents; credit = `db.$transaction([db.user.update({where:{id},data:{balanceCents:{increment:c}}}), db.walletTransaction.create({data:{userId:id,amountCents:c,description}})])`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, fmtMoney } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. NEW: `GiftCode{ code(unique), amountCents, note, redeemedById, redeemedBy, redeemedAt, createdAt }`; `User` has `autoRechargeEnabled, autoRechargeThresholdCents, autoRechargeAmountCents`.

## TASK
1. **Gift/credit codes.**
   - Admin `/admin/gift-codes` (`requireArea("billing")`): create codes (amount + optional note + optional bulk-generate N codes), list with redeemed status/who/when, delete unredeemed. `components/admin/GiftCodeControls.tsx`. Generate codes like `NXEON-XXXX-XXXX` using `crypto`.
   - Customer redeem: `components/customer/RedeemGift.tsx` (`"use client"`) — enter a code → `redeemGiftCode(code)` action: atomically (guard against double-redeem via `updateMany where redeemedById is null`) mark redeemed + credit the wallet + WalletTransaction; clear friendly errors for invalid/already-redeemed.
2. **Wallet auto-recharge preferences (UI + persistence only).** `components/customer/AutoRecharge.tsx` (`"use client"`) — toggle `autoRechargeEnabled`, set threshold + amount (dollars→cents); `saveAutoRecharge(...)` action persists to the User fields. Include a clear note: "Requires a saved card — charging is handled automatically once a payment method is on file." (The actual off-session Stripe charge is wired by the orchestrator; you only build the preferences UI + persistence.)
3. Mount `RedeemGift` + `AutoRecharge` in the customer billing page: EDIT `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` (you are the sole editor this batch) — add a "Redeem a code" card and an "Auto-recharge" card.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `lib/actions-gift.ts` (`"use server"`: create/list/delete/redeem), `lib/actions-billing-prefs.ts` (`"use server"`: saveAutoRecharge), `components/admin/GiftCodeControls.tsx`, `components/customer/RedeemGift.tsx`, `components/customer/AutoRecharge.tsx`, `app/admin/gift-codes/page.tsx`. EDIT (sole owner): `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch layouts/Shell/schema/next.config/rbac/db/auth/lib/actions.ts/lib/stripe.ts/app/api/stripe/**/worker/ROADMAP/docs/sitemap or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only. Redeem must be race-safe (one code, one redemption).

## REPORT
Files created/edited; how gift codes + auto-recharge prefs work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (nav link `/admin/gift-codes`; note the orchestrator must wire the off-session Stripe charge for auto-recharge); risks.

content.text:
All files complete with zero TypeScript errors across the project. Here's my report.

## Files created
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-gift.ts` — `"use server"`: `adminCreateGiftCodes`, `adminDeleteGiftCode`, `redeemGiftCode`
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-billing-prefs.ts` — `"use server"`: `saveAutoRecharge`
- `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/GiftCodeControls.tsx` — `GiftCodeCreateForm`, `DeleteGiftCodeButton`, `CopyCodeButton`
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/RedeemGift.tsx`
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/AutoRecharge.tsx`
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/gift-codes/page.tsx`

## File edited (sole owner)
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` — added imports + a two-up grid with a "Redeem a code" card and an "Auto-recharge" card, placed after the referral banner.

## How it works
**Gift/credit codes.** Admin page (`requireArea("billing")`) generates codes with `crypto.randomInt` in the format `NXEON-XXXX-XXXX` (ambiguous chars 0/O/1/I excluded), retrying on DB collision. The form takes a dollar amount, optional note, and a "how many" count (1–100 bulk). Created codes are shown back with copy-all. The table lists every code with status, redeemer email + time, and offers copy/delete only on unredeemed codes; `adminDeleteGiftCode` refuses to delete a redeemed code. Summary tiles show total/redeemed/outstanding value.

**Redeem (race-safe).** `redeemGiftCode` normalizes/uppercases input, gives friendly errors for invalid/already-redeemed, then inside a `db.$transaction` performs the claim as `giftCode.updateMany({ where: { id, redeemedById: null }, data: {...} })` and aborts if `count !== 1`. Only on a successful claim does it increment `balanceCents` and create the `WalletTransaction`. Two concurrent redemptions of one code can succeed at most once.

**Auto-recharge prefs.** `AutoRecharge` toggles `autoRechargeEnabled` and sets threshold + amount in dollars; `saveAutoRecharge` converts to cents and persists to the three `User` fields (nulls them when disabled), enforcing a $5 minimum top-up when enabled. Includes the required saved-card note. UI + persistence only — no Stripe charge is performed here.

## INTEGRATION NEEDED
- **Admin nav link:** add `{ label: "Gift codes", href: "/admin/gift-codes", icon: ... }` to `app/admin/layout.tsx` (a layout — not mine to touch). Currently the page is reachable only by direct URL.
- **RBAC mapping:** `/admin/gift-codes` is absent from `HREF_AREA` in `lib/rbac.ts`, so `areaForHref` defaults it to `"platform"` (ADMIN-only) for nav-visibility purposes. The page itself gates with `requireArea("billing")`, so BILLING staff can access it, but for consistent nav gating add `"/admin/gift-codes": "billing"` to `HREF_AREA` (not mine to touch).
- **Off-session Stripe charge:** the orchestrator must wire the actual auto-recharge charge (read `autoRechargeEnabled/ThresholdCents/AmountCents`, charge the saved card off-session when balance drops below threshold, then credit the wallet). I built only the preferences UI + persistence.
